# JAMSAQ STUDIO

> JAMSAQ STUDIO is a product design and engineering studio that builds websites, mobile apps, and AI systems for ambitious teams. Founded and led by Saquib. Delicate craft, enduring results.

JAMSAQ STUDIO partners with founders, organisations, and product teams to take ideas from concept to production: marketing and commerce websites, SaaS web apps, native Android and Expo mobile apps, and AI-assisted systems. Work emphasises production fundamentals — type safety, observability, security, accessibility, and careful launch and handover.

## Services

- Websites & Commerce: marketing sites, storefronts, event and conference websites, SaaS surfaces, built with Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS.
- Mobile Apps: native Android (Kotlin / Jetpack Compose) and cross-platform (Expo / React Native) products with real user flows, persistence, notifications, and store release paths.
- AI Systems: retrieval pipelines, local-first AI tooling, and documentation-heavy or safety-sensitive systems built with reviewability in mind.
- Design & Production: high-fidelity prototypes, interaction systems, design languages, deployment, and ongoing care.

## Selected Work

- TASI 2026 Website & App — Conference platform and companion app for Centre For Social Research (Next.js, React Native/Expo, Sanity, Supabase, Clerk).
- Meri Asmita — Survivor-led, privacy-preserving digital safety platform for URL takedown and notice routing (Next.js, Prisma).
- Let's Love — Private couple space mobile app: chat, memories, goals, and shared moments (Expo, React Native, Firebase, RevenueCat). Available on Android.
- Shagun Box — Premium India-first gifting storefront (Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind).
- ShaadiInvite — Mobile-first wedding invitation and RSVP platform (Next.js, Supabase, Razorpay).
- Hadith of the Day — Source-forward hadith reading app (Kotlin Android).

## Process

1. Discover — research, constraints, and alignment before design.
2. Design — high-fidelity prototypes and a living design language.
3. Build — production-grade, type-safe work with weekly demos.
4. Launch & Care — careful deployment, training, and an ongoing relationship.
